subject: integration
name: Orivon Ethereum
summary: The Ethereum Crypto (ETH_0_1): holds no key; turns a site's call into the payload an Account signs and checks the signature recovers to the address. It runs on this computer except the reads for a transaction (chain, nonce, gas, fees) and a typed-data chain id, asked of the person's Ethereum node and taken as answered, unchecked if that node does not prove them. Level 4: it needs no server to derive, encode or check, and what it fills in shows on the sheet, read from the payload bytes, before signing. No privacy: those reads name the person's address. Judged here by its publisher.
